formula_review.PySCF_norm_mode: Cartesian displacement d_i = q_i / sqrt(m_i), where q is the mass-weighted orthonormal eigenvector
formula_review.partition_sum: Four disjoint groups cover all 75 atoms exactly once, hence their per-mode shares sum to one.
formula_review.overlap_scope: The other 18 groups overlap and their aggregate sum is not constrained to one.
numerical_guards: Per-mode maximum absolute rescaling before squaring
Reject zero, complex, nonfinite, wrong-shape modes and invalid masses
Reject duplicate/out-of-range/noninteger indices and bad partitions
Require final Cartesian mass normalization and four-partition sum within stated tolerances
interpretation_limits: Shares describe mass-weighted squared coordinate components, not vibrational energy or IR intensity.
Sign and global display scaling do not change shares.
Individual shares can change under rotation of a degenerate normal-mode basis.
No displacement phase or torsion/bending assignment follows from shares alone.
OH participation does not prove hydrogen bonding or a chemical peak identity.
